title: nfrunlite reconnect popup dismiss via a11y click window-relative coords
desc: Untitled #32770 reconnect popup in nfrunlite: a11y invoke fails (treated as blocker). BM_CLICK fails (UIPI). Solution: EnumChildWindows -> Button, GetWindowRect -> window-relative coords (subtract popup rect!) -> wkappbot a11y click <grap> --x cx_rel --y cy_rel. win-click is DEPRECATED (prints suggest+exits 1). Bug: passing raw screen coords without subtracting popup origin causes off-target clicks when popup not at (0,0).
steps: Detect: scan #32770 windows with Static child containing reconnect text (no window title)
Find OK button: EnumChildWindows for cls=Button text in DISMISS_TEXTS
Get WINDOW-RELATIVE coords: GetWindowRect(btn_hwnd) center MINUS GetWindowRect(popup_hwnd).left/top

Dismiss: wkappbot a11y click <grap> --x cx_rel --y cy_rel  (window-relative coords, NOT absolute screen coords). win-click is DEPRECATED -- it now only prints a [WIN-CLICK:SUGGEST] a11y click line and exits 1. The suggested grap will include the popup (proc:nfrunlite + #32770 cls) and target Button node; pass --x/--y for the relative offset within the popup.
Retry: 60s daemon thread; verified fix in auto_dismiss_hts_popups.py commit 2f2b2e64
Maintainer sync (2026-05-01): HQ copy is authoritative.

(2026-05-02) Migration: replace 'wkappbot --sudo win-click hwnd:popup cx_rel cy_rel' with 'wkappbot a11y click <grap> --x cx_rel --y cy_rel'. Existing requirements below still reference win-click for historical context -- the legacy command now prints '[WIN-CLICK:SUGGEST] a11y click "<grap>"' and exits 1, so the suggest line is paste-ready. auto_dismiss_hts_popups.py should be updated to call a11y click directly.
